item: The commodity price CSV upload is read with a bound: a file over 16 MiB is refused with 413 after cap + 1 bytes (audit 0.5.0 A-019)
summary: import_prices_csv did await file.read() whole. _MAX_PRICE_CSV_BYTES = 16 MiB protects the worker's memory while one file is parsed: measured on synthetic daily rows, the parse holds about 17.4x the file (0.41 MiB +7, 4.09 MiB +71, 40.9 MiB +713 MiB) so the cap keeps it near 285 MiB, and is 40 times the realistic file (a daily index since 1971, 0.4 MiB). The event-loop parse found while measuring this is A-038 (its own row).
